description:
List the numbers a filing document actually states, each with its label.

Each entry is a number with its label (the table row's label, or the words leading
up to it in prose) and its digits with formatting removed, e.g.
{"digits": "416161", "text": "416,161", "label": "Total net sales"}. Any figure you
state from this document must be one of these digit strings times a power of ten
(possibly rounded): 416161 can be cited as $416.2 billion if the table is in millions,
never as $416.9 billion. Work out the scale from the label and the table heading. Tables usually list columns in order
(current period first); confirm the period from the document if it matters.

Use near to filter by label (e.g. "gross margin", "net income"). A 10-K holds about
2,000 figures, so filter unless the document is short (press releases run ~400).
Link an entry by appending "?hl=" + its hl + "&src=mcp#br-hl-0" to highlight_base.

Args:
    cik: CIK of the filer (e.g. "0000320193")
    accession_number: SEC accession number
    filename: Document filename (e.g. "q4fy26cfocommentary.htm")
    near: Keep only figures whose label contains this text (case-insensitive)
    limit: Max figures returned (1-2000, default 300)
name: list_figures
title: List Figures in a Document
